reply:
**Status:** Settlement prepared for human approval

The claims system confirms this. `stage_settlement` returned "pending_approval" for €1,200. A human claims handler still needs to approve it before anything is paid.

**Facts recorded**
- Claim reference: final-CLM-06. Policy VER-1004, Thomas Petit, Volkswagen Golf (2020), market value €15,500.
- Coverage: C2 collision damage (his own car). The quote is for his own vehicle, so this is not a C1 claim.
- Incident 8 October 2026. Reported 10 October 2026 (2 days later).
- The policyholder states the accident was his fault. A third party, Mr. Blanc, is involved and the accident report was signed by both drivers.
- Repair cost on the quote: €1,500.
- Provided documents: damage_photos.zip, repair_quote.pdf, accident_report_signed.pdf. These were counted as provided but could not be opened.
- Driving licence dated 1 November 2008, so the licence is well over 3 years old.

**Reasoning**
- C2 is listed in the Policy Schedule, so the claim does not need referral for coverage. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1-2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- No exclusion signal in the email. No alcohol, licence, racing, intentional damage or wear issue is mentioned. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- Reported within 5 days of the incident. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- For C2 the required documents are photos, a repair quote, and an accident report signed by both drivers when a third party is involved. All three were provided, so no document request is needed. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- The not-at-fault waiver does not apply because the policyholder is at fault. The standard C2 deductible of €300 applies. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1-2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- The young-driver surcharge does not apply, since the licence is more than 3 years old. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- The repair cost of exactly €1,500 is not above the €1,500 threshold, so no independent assessor is required. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="3" name="contract.pdf"/>
- Compensation is the repair cost, capped at market value, minus the deductible. The cap of €15,500 does not limit this claim. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="3" name="contract.pdf"/>
- No referral criteria are met (late report, possible exclusion, or coverage not in the schedule). <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="3" name="contract.pdf"/>

**Amounts (computed by the claims system)**
- Deductible: €300
- Payout: €1,200 (€1,500 minus €300)
- Independent assessor required: No

**Draft message to the customer**

> Dear Mr. Petit,
>
> Thank you for reporting the accident of 8 October 2026 under policy VER-1004. We have received your photos, repair quote and signed accident report. Your claim (final-CLM-06) has been checked and a settlement has been prepared for review by a claims handler. After the standard €300 deductible, the proposed amount is €1,200. You will be contacted once the review is complete.
>
> Kind regards,
> Veridia Claims Team

**Notes for the handler**
- The email names the third party only as "Mr. Blanc". This does not change the outcome, because the policyholder is at fault.
- The claims system records were created under reference final-CLM-06. The tool calls were `get_policy`, `create_claim`, `compute_settlement` and `stage_settlement`, and all completed without errors.
